display.purpose: Find your offline area; 36px desktop and 30px phone.

headline.purpose: Selected-area title; 30px desktop, 27px phone, 24px narrow phone.

body.purpose: Root default; observed supporting copy uses 11–13px.

label.purpose: Compact button and progress labels; primary label becomes 13px on phone.

map-label.purpose: 12px display size at base view from inverse SVG scale; colliding and edge-clipped labels are omitted.

shadows.name: map-overlay
shadows.purpose: Caption, coverage key, and map controls; implemented as --shadow.

shadows.name: action-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary-action hover only; removed when disabled.

motion.name: primary-action
motion.purpose: Primary button state transition; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: map-zoom
motion.purpose: User-controlled zoom transition; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: location-lookup
motion.purpose: Location lookup only; rotation reaches 360deg. Reduced motion removes the animation.

motion.name: file-check
motion.purpose: File checking only; midpoint opacity is .4. Reduced motion removes the animation.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Download, pause, resume, update a pack, or check verified local files. The size segment belongs to download actions.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:'DM Sans Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari',system-ui,sans-serif;height:48px;min-width:270px;padding:0 18px;color:#f8fbf2;border:1px solid var(--green,#254e3d);border-radius:6px;background:var(--green,#254e3d);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;transition:background 160ms,box-shadow 160ms}.ds-primary span{padding-left:13px;margin-left:auto;border-left:1px solid #738b77;color:#e1ead6;font-size:10px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--green-dark,#163b2b);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgb(27 62 41 / 12%)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#37684c);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-primary:disabled{background:#d9dfd2;border-color:#c9d2c1;color:#52614d;box-shadow:none}.ds-primary:disabled span{color:#52614d;border-color:#a3b19a}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-primary{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:13px;height:52px}.ds-primary span{font-size:11px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Install App Action
components.description: Outlined header action for installing the app or activating an available app update.

components.name: Location and Text Actions
components.description: Optional location lookup with its result directly below; ordinary text actions share the unfilled green treatment.
components.html: Location permission was not granted. You can still choose an area manually.
components.css: .ds-location-group{font-family:'DM Sans Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari',system-ui,sans-serif;}.ds-location{font-family:'DM Sans Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari',system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;color:var(--green,#254e3d);padding:10px 0;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:12px;margin-top:4px;min-height:44px;text-align:left;width:100%}.ds-location>svg:last-child{margin-left:auto}.ds-location:hover,.ds-text:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-location:focus-visible,.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#37684c);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-location-result{font-size:12px;color:var(--green,#254e3d);line-height:1.65;margin:2px 0 10px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--green-wash,#e8eddf);border-radius:5px}.ds-text{font-family:'DM Sans Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari',system-ui,sans-serif;border:0;background:none;color:var(--green,#254e3d);font-size:12px;padding:10px 0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-location{min-height:48px}}

components.name: Library Navigation

components.name: Saved State Chip
components.description: Noninteractive verified-local status with icon, label, fill, and border.
components.html: Saved on this device

components.name: Selected Region Row
components.description: Pressed-state region selector with the actual compact New Delhi catalogue drawing, metadata, and chevron. The thumbnail applies the renderer's compact-road filter and limit.
components.css: .ds-area{font-family:'DM Sans Variable','Noto Sans Devanagari',system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;width:293px;padding:13px 10px;min-height:96px;border:1px solid #cad6b8;border-radius:8px;background:#e6ecd9;color:var(--ink,#24352b)}.ds-area:hover{background:#e6ecd9}.ds-area:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#37684c);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-area-thumbnail{width:62px;height:64px;border:1px solid #d2d9c6;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--map-ground,#ecece2)}.ds-area-thumbnail svg{height:100%;width:100%;transform:scale(1.65)}.ds-area-copy{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.ds-area-copy strong{font-weight:650;font-size:13px}.ds-area-copy>span{font-size:11px;color:#52604f}.ds-area-copy small{font-size:10px;color:#57634f;margin-top:3px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-area>svg{margin-left:auto;color:var(--green,#254e3d)}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-area{width:248px;min-height:95px;padding:11px}.ds-area-thumbnail{width:52px;height:61px}.ds-area-copy strong{font-size:14px}.ds-area-copy>span{font-size:12px}.ds-area-copy small{font-size:11px}}

narrative.overview:
OFFGRID is a daylight map utility: mineral paper, forest green, quiet rules, and a real geographic drawing. The interface feels calm, practical, and ready to carry. Its visual weight belongs to coverage; region selection and download controls support that view with compact, factual information.

The system uses one self-hosted sans family, restrained tonal surfaces, and gently curved controls. Status comes from actual local-file and download state. Readiness, connection, and geographic coverage remain distinct ideas in both language and presentation.
keyCharacteristics: Actual vector coverage with a visible boundary and text equivalent.
Selected list rows and horizontal rules rather than nested cards.
Plain language, visible recovery actions, and private optional location.
Phone controls that grow while the information stays compact.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with a label or icon and text; an online indicator never establishes that a map is saved.

rules.name: The Readable Geography Rule
rules.body: Preserve display-sized map labels and collision suppression when the map resizes; reducing label text to fit is not the implemented solution.

rules.name: The Map Overlay Rule
rules.body: Use elevation to keep map controls readable over streets; use rules and tonal selection for the rest of the workspace.

dos: Do preserve the daylight paper, forest action color, restrained rules, and real geographic drawing.
Do show exact coverage, actual download size, and source date before download.
Do keep location feedback beside the initiating control and request location only after that control is pressed.
Do pair every progress, offline, saved, and recovery state with text.
Do preserve display-sized map labels, collision suppression, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do distinguish verified local map files from connectivity and app installation.
donts: Don't present starter coverage as a full-city map or imply a place is guaranteed safe.
Don't replace the actual coverage map with decorative map imagery or synthetic city claims.
Don't use an online indicator or completed animation as proof of offline readiness.
Don't bury recovery guidance away from the control or download state it explains.
Don't replace selected rows and quiet rules with layers of elevated cards.
Don't introduce remote font or map-style dependencies into the offline preparation interface.
narrative.androidWalkingPilot: Paper/forest-green local walking map; top app bar and Back, responsive planner/sheet, collapsed active-guidance controls, readable zoom-invariant labels, explicit focus/error recovery. Native visual and device acceptance pending.
